Stunning four bedroom house on a private road with gated driveway. The expansive property is accessed via a private entrance on the ground floor, with the entrance hallway leading to a front facing bedroom/study, luxuriously finished shower room/WC with double shower enclosure, spacious double bedroom with built-in wardrobes and access to the large, private, rear patio garden.

Stairs lead down from the hallway to the lower ground floor, where you'll find the principle bedroom with wall-to-wall built in storage, access to a private terrace and also the "Jack & Jill" en-suite shower room/WC, which is also accessed by the spacious second bedroom that also benefits from built in storage and has access to its own private terrace.

Taking the stairs back up to the ground floor, then continuing up to the first floor, leads you to the heart of the home. With vaulted ceilings, sky lights and a feature apex window that floods the room with natural light at all times of the day, the reception room is the ideal space for entertaining, relaxing and dining. The open plan kitchen has been custom built, with integrated Bosch appliances and stone worktops, with the central island providing additional dining space, while the rear patio garden can also be reached via a spiral staircase directly from the kitchen.

Externally, the property comes with one off-street allocated parking space, set on the private driveway behind electric gates for additional security.

Vidya Villas are a collection of only 6 exclusive houses, set at the end of a newly forged private road behind electric gates and surrounded by mature oak trees providing a sense of tranquillity, calm and privacy. Each house has been thoughtfully designed by a world renowned architect to maximise light and outside space, providing a unique home environment that is perfect for families or couples looking for an ideal "work from home" setup. The development is superbly located on Shanti Close, just off Bycullah Road in a prime residential location, perfectly situated for local amenities, schools and transport links.

The development is superbly connected for those commuting both to Central London and further afar. Enfield Chase station is just moments away from the property, offering direct connections to Moorgate in just 35 minutes, while those travelling by car are just a couple of miles from both the M25 (leading to the M1) as well as the A10 and A406 (North Circular).

Residents are spoilt for choice for schooling options in the area, with Enfield Grammar school less than a mile away from the property, as well as plenty of good primary schools and nurseries.

Enfield Town is within walking distance, offering a wide range of shopping facilities in Palace Gardens, including a Waitrose supermarket, plus an array of cafes & bars. There are a selection of health care facilities in close proximity of the property too, including BMI Kings Oak Hospital, BMI Cavell Hospital as well as the Chase Farm hospital.
